duplicate_method: 0 byte-identical raw data lines by SHA-256; 0 duplicate rows by pandas parsed-row hashes (64-bit hash collision risk negligible but nonzero)

verified_duplicate_check.method: SHA-256 digest of each raw member data line, excluding the header

derived_representation_assessment.constructible_channels: EARLY snapshot: July 5 values; TRANSITION: July 14 minus July 5 for each matched variable; LATE snapshot: July 14 values
derived_representation_assessment.interpretation_caveat: These labels can only denote first acquisition, between-date difference, and second acquisition. They are not verified phenological stages.
derived_representation_assessment.log_ratio: A log(second/first) is defined only where both date values are strictly positive. 40 of 87 variable pairs are positive for all 325834 rows; the other 47 have at least one row with a non-positive operand.

assumptions_and_limits: UCI feature names are matched between dates by the same base variable name and sensor, differing only by the documented date suffix.
All per-feature ranges and sign counts are calculated from parsed finite numeric values in the local archive member.
Duplicate check includes a raw-line SHA-256 check and a parsed-row hash check; cryptographic/hash collisions are theoretically possible.
No assignment of UCI features to Early/Mid/Late phenological stages is inferred.
